\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{Piece forced onto the dot} & \text{Can the remaining board be filled?}\\ \hline
A & \text{No}\\
B & \text{No}\\
C & \text{No}\\
D & \text{Yes}\\
E & \text{No}
\end{array}
\]

Thus the only valid completion has the \(D\)-piece covering the dotted square.
